L20@P0: Abstract
L21@P0: In this paper we consider several statistics on the set of Dyck paths. Enumeration
L22@P0: of Dyck paths according to length and various other parameters has been studied in
L23@P0: several papers. However, the statistic “number of udu’s” has been considered only
L24@P0: recently. We generalize this statistic and derive an explicit formula for the number of
L25@P0: Dyck paths of length 2n according to the statistic “number of uu · · · udu’s” (“number
L26@P0: of udud · · · udu’s”). As a consequence, we derive several known results, as well as many
L27@P0: new results.
L28@P0: 1 Introduction

L60@P1: Let D be any Dyck path and p be any word on alphabet {u, d}. We say that the Dyck path
L61@P1: D occurs p at low level if D can be decomposed as D = D0pR such that D0is a Dyck path.
L62@P1: Otherwise we say that the Dyck path D occurs p at high level.
L63@P1: The enumeration of Dyck paths according to length and various other parameters has
L64@P1: been studied by several authors [1]-[7]. However, the statistic “number of udu’s” has been
L65@P1: considered only recently [7, 9].
L66@P1: The paper is organized as follows. In Section 2 we consider the statistic “the number of
L67@P1: uu · · · udu’s” and the statistic “the number of udud · · · du’s” in the set of Dyck paths. In
L68@P1: Section 3 we consider these statistics at low and high level in the set of Dyck paths.
